title: What to expect from your first house cleaning in Greer
description: What to expect from your first house cleaning in Greer, SC: how to prepare, what the team does, how long it takes, how pricing works and how to book.
keywords: house cleaning Greer SC, first house cleaning, maid service Greer SC, residential cleaning services Greer, home cleaning Greer

html:
Booking your first professional clean can feel like inviting someone to judge your house. It is the opposite: a good team has seen every kind of home and is there to make yours easier to live in. If you are considering house cleaning in Greer, SC for the first time, here is exactly what to expect, from the first message to the final walk-through.

Greer straddles Greenville and Spartanburg counties (ZIPs 29650, 29651 and 29652), with homes along I-85, SC-14, SC-101 and US-29. Our team is based right here, so most Greer homes are a short drive from our start point, which keeps scheduling flexible.

Step 1: Get your estimate

The process starts with a conversation, not a commitment. You tell us about the home: how many bedrooms and bathrooms, rough square footage, pets, and what you care about most. Photos are the fastest way to get a fixed price, and most quotes come back the same day. There is no need to clean before you send photos.

How much does house cleaning cost in Greer?

Price is based on your home, so no single number fits everyone. The factors are the size of the home, the number of bathrooms, the condition and how long it has been since the last clean, the number of pets, how often you want service and any extras like the inside of the oven or refrigerator. First visits tend to cost more than recurring visits because they take longer. Text photos to (864) 666-8520 or use the Greer house cleaning form. For more detail, read our guide on house cleaning cost in Greer.

Step 2: Prepare the house (10 minutes)

  • Pick up clothes, toys and papers so surfaces and floors are clear
  • Put away valuables and anything fragile you do not want moved
  • Tell us about pets, alarm codes and any areas to skip
  • Leave a note about priorities, such as a cluttered kitchen or a particular bathroom

You do not need to wash dishes or tidy deeply. Tidying is part of the reason you are hiring help.

Step 3: The visit

A team arrives with supplies and equipment and starts at the top of each room. A typical visit includes:

  • Kitchen: counters, sink, stovetop, cabinet fronts, appliance exteriors and floors
  • Bathrooms: toilet, tub or shower, vanity, mirror and floors
  • Bedrooms and living areas: dusting, surfaces, vacuuming and mopping
  • Detail work: baseboards, door frames, switch plates and corners

Perfect Services follows a Brazilian detail-first method. That means we finish one room completely before moving to the next, and we check the details that are easy to miss. See the full house cleaning and maid service page for what is included.

How long does it take?

A first visit in a mid-sized home commonly takes a few hours with a team of two or three. If the home has not been professionally cleaned in a while, we may recommend a one-time deep cleaning first, then regular visits to keep it fresh.

VisitWhat it does
First cleanResets the home and sets the baseline
Second cleanMaintains the baseline, usually quicker
RecurringWeekly, every two weeks or monthly, tuned to your needs

Step 4: After the clean

Walk through the home or review photos if you were out. If anything needs attention, tell us and we will fix it. Many Greer households then choose a weekly, every-other-week or monthly schedule, since regular visits are quicker and keep the house from needing a big reset. Neighbors in Taylors can see house cleaning in Taylors for the same service.

Common first-visit questions

New clients tend to ask the same things, so here are quick answers before you book.

  • Do you bring supplies? Yes. The team arrives with its own products and equipment. If you prefer specific products, or need green cleaning, tell us when you book.
  • Will the same people come each time? We aim to send the same team for recurring clients, so they learn the home and your preferences.
  • What if I am not happy with something? Tell us right away and we will go back and fix it.
  • What about pets? Let us know in advance. We work around pets and can ask you to secure them in one room if needed.

Choosing a frequency

Once your first clean is done, the best frequency depends on your household. Weekly visits suit busy families with pets and children, since messes never build up. Every two weeks is the most popular balance of price and results. Monthly visits work well for smaller households or as a reset between your own cleaning. If you are not sure, start with every two weeks for the first month and adjust. Our guide on weekly, biweekly and monthly maid service goes deeper on this choice.

Book your first clean this week

Ready to see what a detail-first clean looks like? Use the Greer booking form or the home page estimate form and ask for the first open day this week.
faqs: Do I need to clean before the cleaners arrive?
No. Pick up personal items so floors and surfaces are clear, and we will handle the rest.
Do I need to be home?
Not necessarily. Many Greer clients leave access instructions. We can also coordinate if you prefer to be there.
How do I get a price?
Send photos or use the form and we will give you a fixed price, typically the same day.
